remarks: LOOK NO FURTHER! 2/3 bedroom apartment in the heart of SONO with water/city views. Unit completely renovated last JAN. This apartment includes 2/3 bedrooms, 1 office, living room, EIK, 2 full bathrooms & MORE! Two level living! Second floor has 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 full bathroom with tub, living room & EIK. All floors, light fixtures, kitchen appliances, quartz countertops, backsplash, bathroom vanity BRAND NEW! Third floor includes a 3rd spacious bedroom, office, full bathroom with stand up shower, washer/dryer combo & ample closet space. 2-3 assigned parking spaces for your comfort. Upper level utilities included in the rent. Natural Gas for heat, hot water & gas oven/stove along with newer windows keep utilities LOW. Tenants MUST have good credit, proof of income & references. A MUST SEE!
